operator_visible_outcome: Transformation, protocol and Rust worker sources are split by cohesive intent without behavioural or artefact change

inputs.validation: Bounded tracked Go and Rust source, test and artefact inventories

outputs.validation: Deterministic split-inventory acceptance or rejection with a bounded diagnostic

canonical_state: The declared Go and Rust symbol, test, build-tag and artefact inventories are preserved across the split
The Go transformation implementation consists of transform.go, parse.go, host.go and text.go
The Go protocol implementation consists of protocol.go, request.go, response.go and frame.go
The Rust worker implementation consists of main.rs, request.rs, response.rs, grammar.rs and transform.rs
The Rust unit evidence consists of tests/mod.rs, tests/request.rs, tests/response.rs, tests/grammar.rs and tests/transform.rs
The Go protocol unit evidence consists of request_test.go, response_test.go, frame_test.go and fuzz_test.go while benchmarks remain in benchmark_test.go
derived_state: Focused package, conformance, process, artefact and independent Assurance verdicts

success_semantics: Accepted means the exact declared source split preserves symbols, tests, build constraints, protocol bytes, transformation results and artefacts
refusal_semantics: An old monolith, missing destination, undeclared sibling, changed inventory, duplicate implementation, wrapper or semantic regression returns a bounded rejection
failure_semantics: Malformed policy, parse failure or unavailable required tooling fails the gate
cancellation_semantics: Cancellation stops evaluation and cannot produce acceptance
indeterminate_semantics: Missing or contradictory evidence cannot produce acceptance
recovery_semantics: Rerun from the unchanged tracked inventory; no partial policy result is canonical
compatibility_or_reset_policy: Unused pre-release source is split directly; no wrapper, forwarding file, duplicate implementation or compatibility surface is retained
falsifiers: A declaration, test or build constraint changes during the split
An old monolith remains or a destination file is missing
An undeclared sibling source or test file appears in a governed split directory
A wrapper, duplicate validator or order dependency is introduced
Diagnostics, failure distinctions or unsupported-platform refusal change

production_controls.owner: source-policy split inventory and declaration fixtures
source-policy split inventory and focused package fixtures
Go package, Rust unit, process and release artefact tests

assurance_controls.owner: independent split inventory and declaration comparison
independent split inventory and rulepack checks
independent URL rulepack, model and artefact inspection

residual_limitations: This structural split does not establish new operation behaviour
Native Windows execution remains separately governed
Exact-pair sign-off requires committed clean Product and Assurance candidates
non_goals: Change orchestration, diagnostics, failure classification or platform refusal
Create an interface, wrapper, registry, option or duplicate implementation
Retain the old monolith as a forwarding or compatibility file
Change admission, transformation, protocol, persistence, supervision or worker behaviour
deletion_criteria: Delete this slice contract only when a later reviewed contract explicitly supersedes the split inventory
